vyacheslavite.e: From Vyacheslav + -ite, named after Russian mineralogist Vyacheslav Gavilovich Melkov.

vysotskite.e: After N. K. Vysotskii, Soviet geologist, + -ite

vyshyvanka.e: From Ukrainian вишива́нка (vyšyvánka). Compare Belarusian вышыва́нка (vyšyvánka).
